Amul and Mother Dairy Announce Milk Price Hikes

Amul and Mother Dairy have announced price increases for their milk products, effective November 12. Prices are set to rise by Rs 2 to Rs 4 per litre across various milk variants. Mother Dairy's full cream milk will now cost Rs 76 per litre, and toned milk will be priced between Rs 60-62 per litre in Delhi-NCR. The companies cited higher procurement costs as the reason for the price adjustments.
